rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something lacking an individual personality or personal stamp.

example.english: This announcement is too formulaic and completely impersonal.
example.traditional: 呢篇公告寫得太公式化，完全冇個人色彩。
example.jyutping: ne1 pin1 gung1 gou3 se2 dak1 taai3 gung1 sik1 faa3 jyun4 cyun4 mou5 go3 jan4 sik1 coi2

rows.note: Use this when a person, tone, or manner feels emotionally cold and detached.

example.english: The receptionist’s tone was so impersonal that you felt unwelcome.
example.traditional: 個接待員把聲好冷漠，問多句都嫌你煩。
example.jyutping: go3 zip3 doi6 jyun4 baa2 seng1 hou2 laang5 mok6 man6 do1 geoi3 dou1 jim4 nei5 faan4

rows.note: Use this as the grammatical term for a verb or construction with no referential subject.

example.english: “It is raining” is an impersonal construction.
example.jyutping: lok6 jyu5 laa3 ne1 geoi3 hai6 mou4 jan4 cing1 geoi3 sik1
